```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4, message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE)
```

This short example constructs an areal dataset, generates Moran eigenvector maps,
and fits iVAE and iVAEar using the Moran auxiliary option.

```{r areal-generation, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(NonlinearBSS)

set.seed(1)
areal <- generate_areal_units(n_area = 30, n_fine = 600,
                             seed_type = "uniform", seed = 1)

src <- simulate_sources_areal(p = 3, areal = areal, n_time = 20,
                              n_segments_time = 5,
                              sd_range = c(0.3, 1.2),
                              ar_range = c(0.4, 0.8), seed = 2)
```

First, we plot the actual areal units and their borders, without any fill color.

```{r areal-boundaries}
ggplot(areal$areas_sf) +
  geom_sf(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

## Example areal sources

The first three latent sources are shown at a single time point over the true areal units.

```{r source-plot}
source_sf <- areal$areas_sf
source_sf$source1 <- src$sources[seq_len(nrow(source_sf)), 1]
source_sf$source2 <- src$sources[seq_len(nrow(source_sf)), 2]
source_sf$source3 <- src$sources[seq_len(nrow(source_sf)), 3]

source_sf_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(component = "Source 1", value = source_sf$source1, geometry = source_sf$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Source 2", value = source_sf$source2, geometry = source_sf$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Source 3", value = source_sf$source3, geometry = source_sf$geometry)
)
source_sf_long <- sf::st_as_sf(source_sf_long)
source_sf_long$component <- factor(source_sf_long$component,
                                  levels = c("Source 1", "Source 2", "Source 3"))

ggplot(source_sf_long) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(fill = "value")
```

## Moran eigenvector maps

The spatial structure is described by positive Moran eigenvectors of the areal adjacency matrix.

```{r moran-plot}
moran_spec <- aux_moran(neighborhood = areal$W, K = 10, positive_only = TRUE)
moran_fit <- NonlinearBSS:::fit_aux(moran_spec,
                                   NonlinearBSS:::nlbss_data(matrix(0, nrow(areal$W), 0),
                                                            require_x = FALSE))
mem <- moran_fit$mem[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
mem_sf <- areal$areas_sf
mem_sf$mem1 <- mem[, 1]
mem_sf$mem2 <- mem[, 2]
mem_sf$mem3 <- mem[, 3]

mem_sf_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(component = "MEM 1", value = mem_sf$mem1, geometry = mem_sf$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "MEM 2", value = mem_sf$mem2, geometry = mem_sf$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "MEM 3", value = mem_sf$mem3, geometry = mem_sf$geometry)
)
mem_sf_long <- sf::st_as_sf(mem_sf_long)
mem_sf_long$component <- factor(mem_sf_long$component,
                               levels = c("MEM 1", "MEM 2", "MEM 3"))

ggplot(mem_sf_long) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(fill = "value")
```

## Fitting iVAE and iVAEar with Moran auxiliary data

```{r tf-models, eval = tf_available()}

time <- src$time
mix <- mix_data(src$sources, n_layers = 2, nonlinearity = "elu",
                final_activation = "none")

aux_spec <- aux_moran(neighborhood = areal$W, K = 10)

fit_ivae <- iVAE(mix, aux = aux_spec, latent_dim = 3,
                 coords = NULL, time = time,
                 epochs = 10, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0, seed = 1)

fit_ivaear <- iVAEar(mix, aux = aux_spec, latent_dim = 3,
                    group = src$group, time = time,
                    epochs = 10, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0, seed = 1)
```

```{r tf-component-plots, eval = tf_available()}
# Use a single time point for areal maps to align with the graph structure.
t <- 1L
plot_ivae <- areal$areas_sf
plot_ivae$component1 <- fit_ivae$S[time == t, 1]
plot_ivae$component2 <- fit_ivae$S[time == t, 2]
plot_ivae$component3 <- fit_ivae$S[time == t, 3]

plot_ivae_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(component = "Component 1", value = plot_ivae$component1,
             geometry = plot_ivae$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Component 2", value = plot_ivae$component2,
             geometry = plot_ivae$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Component 3", value = plot_ivae$component3,
             geometry = plot_ivae$geometry)
)
plot_ivae_long <- sf::st_as_sf(plot_ivae_long)
plot_ivae_long$component <- factor(plot_ivae_long$component,
                                  levels = c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"))

ggplot(plot_ivae_long) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(fill = "estimated component")

plot_ivaear <- areal$areas_sf
plot_ivaear$component1 <- fit_ivaear$S[time == t, 1]
plot_ivaear$component2 <- fit_ivaear$S[time == t, 2]
plot_ivaear$component3 <- fit_ivaear$S[time == t, 3]

plot_ivaear_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(component = "Component 1", value = plot_ivaear$component1,
             geometry = plot_ivaear$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Component 2", value = plot_ivaear$component2,
             geometry = plot_ivaear$geometry),
  data.frame(component = "Component 3", value = plot_ivaear$component3,
             geometry = plot_ivaear$geometry)
)
plot_ivaear_long <- sf::st_as_sf(plot_ivaear_long)
plot_ivaear_long$component <- factor(plot_ivaear_long$component,
                                    levels = c("Component 1", "Component 2",
                                               "Component 3"))

ggplot(plot_ivaear_long) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  labs(fill = "estimated component")
```
